status: aggregate frame only; no draw, cohort or dispatch authority
source: Crossref annotated funder names, Zenodo release 19699937; ROR v2.6
unit: one unambiguous deposited name per independent organization/name family

draw_after_approval_only.family_key: decimal seq_no values sorted numerically and joined with comma, no spaces
draw_after_approval_only.family_order: ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 seed/stratum/family_key, then family_key lexically; stratum is positive or empty
draw_after_approval_only.one_representative: ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 seed/row/seq_no, then numeric seq_no; take first, with no within-family replacement
draw_after_approval_only.recruitment: take first 20 in each queue for yield assessment only; after continuation approval use queue order up to quota or ceiling
draw_after_approval_only.collisions: remove all families overlapping development; merge verified within-holdout collisions and keep earliest eligible nomination using ascending family-order hash across strata; unresolved or label-conflicting components excluded
draw_after_approval_only.no_promotion: retain source labels; exclude unsupported, disputed or stratum-discordant records; never reassign strata or replace from a different family outside the queue

stop: any pin or overlap-ledger mismatch, unresolved split integrity, insufficient reviewed yield by ceiling, or failure to meet both quotas; report shortfall and obtain a versioned design decision
